title: Square-root bound at half bias
statement: Let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function. For $S\\subseteq[n]$, write $\\widehat f(S)=\\mathbb E_x[f(x)\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i]$ for its uniform Fourier coefficient, and set $P_f(q)=\\bigl(1-\\sum_{S\\subseteq[n]}(1-2q)^{|S|}\\widehat f(S)\\bigr)/2$. If $0<p_c<1/2$ and $P_f(p_c)=1/2$, then $1-P_f(1/2)\\le\\sqrt{p_c/2}$.
